name: Pupa Project
source:
Lepidoptera Lunatic Asylum opens its gates to you, beckoning you inside to come and pick up the pieces of splintered minds. Our story begins one year after Blythe Waldrop had been admitted to the asylum. Between navigating the harsh conditions of a Victorian institution, and learning what it means to truly heal, you will help Blythe understand what it means to be free. 

While this story only has one ending, the choices you help Blythe make just might restore the fragments you need to piece together the whole picture. So choose carefully, it’s time to see the world through her eyes. 

[From [url=https://timoogi.itch.io/pupa-project]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
鳞翅目疯人院向你敞开大门，召唤你进来捡起破碎的心灵碎片。我们的故事开始于布莱斯·沃尔德罗普进入精神病院一年后。在了解维多利亚机构的恶劣条件和了解真正治愈意味着什么之间，你将帮助布莱斯了解自由意味着什么。

虽然这个故事只有一个结局，但你帮助布莱斯做出的选择可能会恢复你拼凑整个故事所需的碎片。所以要慎重选择，是时候通过她的眼睛看世界了。

[来自[url=https://timoogi.itch.io/pupa-project]itch.io[/url]]
